description: This script manages external web dependencies for the coocook project, including downloading and installing dependencies specified in a YAML configuration file. It defines a WebDependency class for handling individual dependencies and contains functions for downloading and extracting dependencies.

classes.name: WebDependency
classes.description: Represents an external web dependency with methods for downloading, extracting, and printing status messages.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for WebDependency, initializes dependency attributes and prepares the fetch object.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the dependency.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the dependency.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version of the dependency.

methods.name: ff
methods.description: Returns the File::Fetch object associated with the dependency.

methods.name: extract_paths
methods.description: Returns the list of paths to extract from the archive.

methods.name: archive_name
methods.description: Returns the filename of the archive to be downloaded.

methods.name: print_command
methods.description: Prints a status message indicating the current command being executed for the dependency.

methods.name: print_status
methods.description: Prints the status of the last operation (SUCCESS, CACHED, FAILED).

methods.name: download
methods.description: Fetches the dependency archive from the URL to the specified destination directory.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts the archive contents into the appropriate directory, handling different archive formats.
